marta: Heads-up: Vendor-Sync reported a spike of "expired entitlements" after their heartbeat gateway delayed by 25m. Customers lost temporary access and saw downstream billing gaps.

lee: can you share logs/sample event?

vendor-sync: sample heartbeat events (sanitized): ```json
{
  "device_id": "VS-320",
  "heartbeat_ts": "2026-03-22T09:10:00Z",
  "seq": 1023
}
```
We sent the above but our gateway retried and final delivery landed at 09:38Z.

marta: our entitlement expiry policy currently considers a device inactive after 15m of no heartbeat. that 25m gap caused entitlement TTL to expire and billing engine to mark usage windows as closed.

lee: immediate mitigation: extend entitlement grace window to 45m for affected partners while we patch detection. ops-bot: create ticket?

ops-bot: created PARTNER-3805: "Vendor-Sync late heartbeat TTL grace window + reconciliation" assigned to lee. https://redwood.internal/partners/3805

vendor-sync: thanks. we will throttle retries and include original_event_ts in payload so ingestion can reassign to original window. adding header X-Original-Ts. ETA 24h.

marta: detection idea: if an event's original_event_ts is > grace_window and <= 2xgrace_window, mark record as "late-arrival" and route to reconciliation. billing should not auto-close windows for hours with late-arrivals until reconciliation run.

lee: reconciliation plan: nightly job that looks for hours with late-arrivals and recomputes entitlements for those hours. SQL prototype: ```sql
UPDATE hourly_entitlements he
SET units = sub.sum_units
FROM (SELECT device_id, date_trunc('hour', original_event_ts) hr, sum(units) sum_units
      FROM late_partner_events
      WHERE processed = false
      GROUP BY device_id, hr) sub
WHERE he.device_id = sub.device_id AND he.hour = sub.hr;
```
Mark late_partner_events.processed = true after update.

marta: add monitoring: alert when count(late-arrivals) > 50/min for any partner or when entropy of seq numbers suggests retries.

vendor-sync: we'll include original_event_ts and a monotonic seq in next push. also add a signed delivery token so you can trust original timestamps.

lee: dev estimate: short-term grace window flip + alerting ~3h, nightly reconciliation job ~6h, acceptance tests ~2h. we'll ship the grace window change within the hour as a safety valve.

marta: customer comms: small set of affected customers may see entitlement corrections; finance asked we surface corrections as "late-ingest entitlement adj" line item and not as refunds. @marketplace please prep wording.

marketplace: will draft wording and billing impact estimate. note: avoid partner names in customer-facing comms.

marta: follow-ups: 1) patch partner docs to require original_event_ts header and idempotency headers, 2) add partner onboarding test for heartbeat delivery SLA, 3) ensure reconciliation job runs in a committed/atomic way. I'll follow up in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
